author: Lindsey Lukehurst
quote: I love this particular bag, and when the zip started to go after about 5 years I wanted another one.
paraphrase: She likes the bag but the zip failed after about five years and the replacement is slightly smaller.

author: Mrs Currie
quote: A wonderful bag! Well made. Looks as good as the photos show.
paraphrase: Finds the bag well made, matching its photos; bought Nordace before.

author: Julieboo
quote: Well worth the money Received the bag in a lovely box and inside a lovely dusting.
paraphrase: Price justified, nice packaging and material.

author: B Merch
quote: From the product description to the ease in ordering, prompt delivery and an exceptional product, Nordace rocks!
paraphrase: Praises ordering, fast delivery; crossbody bag fits essentials.

author: 箕村直也
quote: The design was nice, but it broke one month after I bought it.
paraphrase: Liked the look but bag broke within a month, a button unusable.

author: Mandy
quote: It did take quite a while to arrive, and I thought it wasn't going to but then it did.
paraphrase: Slow delivery, doubted it would arrive; likes style, pockets, light weight.

author: Angelika
quote: The delivery was super fast, great product, fantastic quality, I absolutely love my new bag!
paraphrase: Very quick shipping, delighted with quality.

author: Sandra
quote: BUT it stains very easily and the stains do not come out.
paraphrase: Beige bag light and roomy but stains easily and stains won't come out, so she can't use it.

author: Peggy
quote: I love this high quality bag. It is just the right size to fit all my necessities
paraphrase: High quality, lightweight, organized, works as an extra carry-on.

author: bonnie mills
quote: Great product. And reputable company.
paraphrase: Initially hesitated over the brand, satisfied with the Sierra bundle and now trusts the company.

author: Emma
quote: The material resists scuffs and wipes clean easily, so it keeps looking sharp through heavy use.
paraphrase: Tote material holds up and cleans easily; praises layout.

author: Siempreviva
quote: Delivery was spot on.
paraphrase: Delivery on time; pleased with compartments and quality.

author: Rich Al-Chalabi
quote: the main zipper broke due to metal fatigue
paraphrase: Backpack for his wife failed in about a year; says customer service stopped responding.

author: Kija Bowerman
quote: Super bag but upon reflection greatly over priced
paraphrase: Likes the bag but feels it is overpriced.

author: Simon
quote: they make you pay for return shipping unless it was defective.
paraphrase: Likes style and quality but objects to paying return postage for non-defective items.

author: Lf
quote: the snap closure on the front smart pocket does not stay snapped very well and keeps popping open.
paraphrase: Front pocket snap on Eclat crossbody keeps coming undone.

author: Rebecca Penney
quote: Lovely quality bag! Compliments all my outfits.
paraphrase: Well made, goes with every outfit, used daily.

author: Marion Forshaw
quote: Excellent bag with useful pockets. It takes a lot of bits and pieces.
paraphrase: Roomy and well-pocketed but doesn't understand how the charging feature works.

author: Maggie
quote: This is a nice smaller size tote bag/ carryon
paraphrase: Petite overpacker finds this smaller tote ideal.

author: customer
quote: It arrived very quickly and I have used it on a holiday and it was all I wanted
paraphrase: Arrived fast and worked well on holiday.
